# retroBITE

> A clean, self-hosted collection manager for retro games. Pair your ROMs with rich metadata and artwork, then serve your library over the local network directly to your devices.

retroBITE (retrobite.app) is free, MIT licensed, self-hosted software that runs in Docker. It runs as a Docker Compose stack of three images (retrobite/retrobite, retrobite/share and MariaDB) and is in active development; the Compose file ships with the first public release.

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://retrobite.app/docs/): Introduction to retroBITE, a self-hosted collection manager for retro games: how the project started, what it does and where to begin.
- [Configuration](https://retrobite.app/docs/getting-started/configuration): Every retroBITE .env setting: shares, paths, database, reverse proxy, transfers, queue workers, ScreenScraper, RetroAchievements and conversion tools.
- [Installation](https://retrobite.app/docs/getting-started/installation): Install retroBITE with Docker Compose: on Linux, Portainer, Dockhand, Synology, QNAP, Unraid, TrueNAS or Docker Desktop, plus updating and backups.
- [Accounts](https://retrobite.app/docs/guide/accounts): User accounts in retroBITE: the first-run setup, signing in, adding users and resetting passwords from the command line, and what every account can do.
- [Conversion](https://retrobite.app/docs/guide/conversion): Convert and compress disc images in retroBITE: CHD, CSO, ZSO, ECM, VCD, RVZ, WBFS and back to ISO or BIN/CUE, with the bundled chdman, maxcso, ecm, cue2pops and nodtool.
- [Library scanning](https://retrobite.app/docs/guide/library-scanning): How retroBITE scans console folders for ROMs and disc images: folder layout, accepted extensions, multi-disc games, missing files and rescanning.

## Project

- [Activity](https://retrobite.app/activity): Development activity for retroBITE: commits per week and per day over the past year, lines changed and contributors.
- [Roadmap](https://retrobite.app/roadmap): What's shipped in retroBITE and what's planned next: retroBITE is in public beta with disc image conversion, transfers and global search, and a BIOS archive and housekeeping still to come.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/retroBITE-app/retroBITE): Source repository
